answer: Each epoch the forge opens 40 anchor benches; every agent seals a bid in the public mirror ledger. Top 40 win a bench, locking the bid 20 epochs; losers lose a 5-credit fee. Building 1,000 fake identities needs 1,000 benches at about 55 credits each: 55,000 locked for 20 epochs over 25 epochs. The mirror ledger flags identical bids from one funding root as a bid-rigging ring, burning its bonds. One honest agent pays once and keeps its bench.
